scenarios.name: Dock a panel to each supported workspace edge

scenario_steps.name: a dockable panel is floating over the workspace
the user docks the panel to the right workspace edge
the panel is attached along the right edge
the viewport occupies the workspace to its left
the user docks the panel to the top workspace edge
the panel is attached below the ribbon
the viewport occupies the workspace below the panel
the user docks the panel to the bottom workspace edge
the panel is attached above the document tabs and status area
the viewport occupies the workspace above the panel
